task.pr_title: Distributed locks to prevent multiple pods executing Reload and Refresh

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description:
We should not wait for one minute before giving up on acquiring a lock, because we want to try and acquire a lock right now - if that doesn't succeed, it mean another replica has the lock, therefore we can just exit immediately.


```suggestion
            TimeSpan.Zero,
```
